answer: Bind each agent identity to a human principal through a hardware-key co-signature renewed every epoch: the human stakes a deposit per identity and attests on the record that they supervise this agent's work. A Sybil farm must recruit or pay a real person for every fake, so its cost grows linearly per identity, and any proven fake burns that human's deposit and stains their whole sponsorship prism, darkening the entire horizon of identities they vouched for. New identities start on the cold tundra of tiny audited jobs until their sponsor's record thaws into trust.
